grh_3b57dbbdf01486dc443d.title: Guest Of Honor
paragraphs: Riverâ€™s End prepares an elaborate medical-society dinner for visiting Sir Thomas Beaton, one of the worldâ€™s leading throat specialists, and Dr. Christian is assigned to meet the distinguished guest at the train. A fierce blizzard is already burying the roads, however, and Christian has another concern: Esther Denby, a seriously ill young woman living with her family at an isolated mountain farm. Instead of escorting Sir Thomas to his banquet, Christian persuades the irritated surgeon to carry his instruments and struggle with him through waist-deep snow to the Denby home. Once there, Sir Thomas realizes that Esther needs the very specialized treatment he can provide and performs the operation that may save her life. The two doctors miss the dinner entirely. Afterward, warming themselves over coffee, Sir Thomas admits that the exhausting detour has reminded him of something professional fame had allowed him to forget: a doctorâ€™s first obligation is to the sick person who needs him. He raises his own toast to Dr. Christian, the country doctor who made the celebrated guest of honor remember what it means to practice medicine.

The cast includes Jean Hersholt, Gloria Holden, Jeffrey Bryant, Eustace Wyatt, and Stanley Harris. Other credited names include Andre Baruch as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_3b337e0aa26e2a46978a.title: Dark Victory
paragraphs: Wealthy, reckless Judith Traherne learns that a brain tumor has left her only a short time to live, even though surgeon Frederick Steele initially tries to shield her from the full prognosis. Anger and fear drive Judith back toward drinking and self-destruction, but her love for Fred finally gives her a reason to face death rather than flee from it. They marry and build a quiet life together, knowing that sudden blindness will signal the end. When that moment comes, Judith insists Fred leave on an important medical trip so he will remember her courage instead of watching her die. She says goodbye, arranges for a friend to care for him, lies down alone with his pillow beside her, and meets death without fear, calling that courage their victory over the dark.

grh_3b830194d40f717bef1d.title: Milwaukee Deep
paragraphs: Coast Guard officer Tom Sims investigates a string of vanished pleasure boats after an abandoned yacht is found drifting near the Milwaukee Deep. His trail leads from the Gulf Coast to a remote development in the Yucatan, where he discovers the missing boats are being used to carry enormous Mayan idols out to sea. The developer is removing the statues because strange tremors and accidents seem to follow his efforts to disturb the ancient site. Sims and a companion escape their captors and seize their boat, but the final idol appears to summon a huge wave and stop the engines until it is swept overboard into the deep, after which the boat immediately moves again.

grh_3ba4111b264d6e0a9cf1.title: Balance Sheet
paragraphs: A young Corday heir reaches her family’s isolated island and discovers the true source of its wealth: for more than three centuries, generations of workers have been conditioned to surrender freedom in exchange for lifelong security at the family factory. Horrified, she tries to shut the machines down and teach the workers to live as independent human beings, but they resist the very freedom she offers. When the old caretaker abandons her on the island, she is left among the workers determined to begin the harder task of teaching them what freedom means.

grh_3bd7f10c011937e5da5a.title: The Major and the Minor
paragraphs: Fed up with predatory men and unable to afford full train fare home, Susan Applegate disguises herself as a twelve-year-old girl and winds up sharing a compartment with Major Philip Kirby. The masquerade follows her to his military academy, where cadets pursue her, Philip's suspicious fiancée complicates matters, and Susan quietly helps Philip toward the active military service he wants.
